title: Central Bank Gold Statistics: September 2026
gist: Central banks bought 61t of gold in September 2026, the year's highest monthly total, led by Poland and China; YTD purchases are 228t, 7% below last year.

insights.claim: Central banks reported 61 tonnes of net gold purchases in September 2026, the highest monthly total of the year so far.
insights.speaker: World Gold Council
insights.so_what: Official-sector demand is re-accelerating into Q4.

insights.claim: Poland and China led September buying, with Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Jordan, the Czech Republic and Bolivia also net buyers.
insights.speaker: World Gold Council
insights.so_what: Emerging and central European central banks remain the marginal buyers.

insights.claim: Year-to-date through September, central banks reported 228 tonnes of net gold purchases, 7% lower than the same period last year.
insights.speaker: World Gold Council
insights.so_what: Pace is slightly slower than 2025 but still elevated.

insights.claim: These figures cover only publicly reported changes and differ from the Gold Demand Trends series, which adds an estimate of unreported buying.
insights.speaker: World Gold Council
insights.so_what: Reported data understate total official buying.
